state.source_change: The provider validates data_len in [0,248] and rejects positive-length NULL data before allocation. For the selected MT7996 profile only (txbuf_min_size == 0xe000), command WLAN_FUNC_SET_WAIT_INODE_TXRX_REG_ADDR (24) gets at least 16 zero-initialized payload bytes plus its 8-byte header. It copies only caller data_len bytes. Other valid profiles/commands keep the original 8+data_len length; full INODE payloads retain all caller bytes. GET and native helper bodies are unchanged.
state.framing_evidence: Compiled actual provider C emits 1056 matching frames across three profiles, two commands, all16 selectors and11 lengths. Thirty validation/allocation/transport controls pass with ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer. Five mutants are rejected. All16 original native wrapper entries reject the old declared12-byte frame; all16 corrected24-byte frames cover original reads at offsets0,20,16,12,8 and reach the helper entry with zero extra words. These runs stop BEFORE executing the selector helper.
state.binary_evidence: The rebuilt image's actual packaged AArch64 sender executes 1056 matching frames and30 controls under Unicorn. The original target instructions execute, while kmalloc/memcpy/kfree/fortify and internal mailbox transport are modeled. No physical mailbox, DMA, IRQ completion or coherent reservation is exercised.
state.build_evidence: Full Linux6.18.52 world build exits0. Offline FIT/board/firmware checks,218 packages,78 module ABIs and60 source-lock files pass. Current image SHA256031f7bd2b28e0507ddfe810602a7edef71c63900244935e7d460ab58ab35a0cc. No new flash or hardware test occurred.
state.limits: The original bounce allocation is256 bytes, so the old mismatch is an undeclared stale-tail read, not a demonstrated physical allocation overflow. Earlier selectors2/7/4 ignored extra words. Padding alone is not an established Wi-Fi root cause or readiness fix. Full cold containment, loader identity/storage/publication, real callers, native postgate, DMA drains/teardown/rearm and actual-client acceptance remain incomplete.
